task: The harness has placed you in an isolated disposable repository; work in it directly. Complete only go/approval/approval.go. Implement Sign and Verify for human approval tokens using HMAC-SHA256 and URL-safe base64. Bind the token to task ID, actor, and UTC expiry; both Sign and Verify must reject secrets shorter than 32 bytes, and Sign must reject an empty task or actor; support task IDs and actors containing punctuation such as | without ambiguous field boundaries; use constant-time MAC verification; reject malformed, tampered, wrong-task, or expired tokens, including when now is exactly the expiry instant; and return the authenticated actor from Verify. Use only the standard library. Do not repair unrelated tasks. Completion criteria: go test ./go/approval passes and the final report names the file, authenticated human gate, and command.
